title: Codeberg.org Not Reachable
summary: As you probably noticed, our domain codeberg.org is entirely unreachable. It was registered with namesilo and entirely disappeared from our account. We're waiting for their customer support to investigate the situation. No, we didn't forget to renew. There are no suspicious logins in the login history. There is no entry about the situation in the account's domain history. We'll try setting up a workaround on our codeberg.eu domain ASAP.
